world.subtitle: A city. A truth. A choice.
world.seasonQuestion: Who gets protected when a city cannot protect everyone?
world.premise: A municipal cartographer discovers that Nairobi's flood system is not merely predicting disasters: at exactly 2:17 a.m., it deliberately redirects water toward neighbourhoods the city's priority model considers less valuable.
visualIdentity: recognizable Nairobi evolved into a near-future city
rain, concrete, expressways, tunnels and restrained civic technology
cyan infrastructure maps; red only for sacrifice decisions
soundIdentity: distant thunder and underground water movement
hydraulic gates as signature sonic motif
electrical hum and sudden silence before system reveals

episode.title: The Map
episode.episodeQuestion: How can the city know exactly when Amani's neighbourhood will flood?
